newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks drift, lost for direction.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks drift, lost for direction.

text.p: Tokyo stocks fluctuated narrowly in early Wednesday trade, hunting for clear direction, brokers said.
Financial issues led by Nomura Securities Co Ltd were weak, but sectors related to domestic demand such as telecommunications were steady, offsetting losses, they said.

As of 0028 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was up 15.70 yen at 20,144.81. June Nikkei futures added 40 points to trade at 20,220. "Stocks are now at a level where it is difficult to sell heavily, but on the other hand, there are no really strong incentives to buy," a dealer at a middle-sized brokerage said.
